arx_integration_phases.v1-entry: Team-level live operations layer (currently operating). arx runtime-depends only on crucible-rust + custos.

guild-systems.description_en: Neutral, cross-tenant infrastructure owned by The Alephain Guild. Composed of open-source and proprietary components. Consumed by any business tenant.
guild-systems.description_zh: 由 Alephain Guild 拥有的中立、跨租户基础设施。由开源与自有组件共同构成。任何业务租户均可消费。

sub_layers.l1-foundation: Foundation business capabilities and canonical state owners (crucible-rust, and Phase 3/4 integration targets: speculum, athanor, argus, synedrion, nummus, fama)
sub_layers.l2-kernel: Authorization + orchestration kernel (arx). Composes L1 foundation capabilities and issues signed intent for L3 execution.
sub_layers.l3-edge: Per-tenant local runtime (custos). Consumes signed commands from L1; runs on tenant hardware; never hosted by the Guild.

cross_layer_invariants.en: custos is never hosted by the Guild. Every tenant — first-party or third-party — runs their own custos on their own machine. This is the non-custodial invariant.
cross_layer_invariants.zh: custos 永远不由 Guild 托管。每个租户(一方或第三方)都在自己的机器上跑 custos。这是 non-custodial 承诺的基石。

cross_layer_invariants.en: ARX and Crucible are Guild-hosted shared infrastructure. Tenants consume them; they do not fork them (unless leaving the ecosystem entirely).
cross_layer_invariants.zh: ARX 与 Crucible 是 Guild 托管的共享基础设施。租户消费它们,不需要自建(除非完全脱离生态)。

cross_layer_invariants.en: Being an ARX tenant is an architectural fact, not a branding one. Tenant landing pages MUST NOT use tenant vocabulary in public copy.
cross_layer_invariants.zh: 成为 ARX 租户是架构事实,不是品牌事实。租户的 landing 公开文案不得使用 tenant 术语。

cross_layer_invariants.en: arx's 8 subsystem integrations happen in phases. Only crucible-rust and custos are runtime dependencies today. Speculum, athanor, argus enter in Phase 3; synedrion, nummus, fama enter in Phase 4. Public copy MUST NOT claim integrations that are not yet operating.
cross_layer_invariants.zh: arx 对 8 个子系统的集成分阶段推进。当前(v1 入口段)仅 crucible-rust 与 custos 是运行时依赖;speculum / athanor / argus 于 Phase 3 平台段接入;synedrion / nummus / fama 于 Phase 4 网络段接入。公开文案不得宣称尚未运行的集成。

cross_layer_invariants.en: Guild-layer infrastructure is composed of both open-source and proprietary components. crucible-rust is proprietary; custos is open-source; arx visibility is TBD. Do not conflate 'Guild-owned' with 'open source' in public copy.
cross_layer_invariants.zh: Guild 层基础设施由开源与自有组件共同构成。crucible-rust 是自有;custos 是开源;arx 可见性待定。公开文案不得把'Guild 拥有'与'开源'混为一谈。

cross_layer_invariants.en: Proprietary components (crucible-rust) MUST be visibly labeled ▲ PROPRIETARY on all public landing surfaces. Honesty over hiding — partial-open stack is the truth.
cross_layer_invariants.zh: 自有组件(crucible-rust)在所有公开 landing 上必须显示 ▲ PROPRIETARY 标签。诚实 > 隐藏 —— 部分开源是事实。
